items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: I played with a finger and thumb.

ctx.x: You own one? Yeah. How long ago did you, when? I played on the air. On the tour, I looked up, on the air.

Larry Burndes had a twelve string guitar. You know. So, he had twelve strings on it and I took on nine strings. You took nine strings? Right. And left the rest of them in there. And I played with a finger and thumb. Finger and thumb.
You told, you said you played When the Saints Go Marching In. I don't know what that's right.
